slices.focus: During a quiet spell, a coworker invites Ayaka to a used bookstore where she discovers an out-of-print local history book, sharpening her reading interest toward Fukuoka harbor history.
slices.summary: A maintenance clerk invites Ayaka to browse secondhand bookstores near Tenjin. She finds an out-of-print book on island shipping routes, which becomes a train-ride companion. Her reading interest sharpens from general regional history and infrastructure nonfiction toward local harbor history and island shipping routes specifically. She keeps a light phone list of authors and neighborhoods.
open_loops: New reading habit could become another system/project if over-structured
Book-buying could conflict with tighter budget
Social connection with the clerk may or may not deepen
decisions: Ayaka's book preferences broadened from general regional-history and infrastructure nonfiction to a stronger interest in
